fun_facts: DJ Moore is from Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
At Maryland in 2017, he earned first-team All-Big Ten honors and Big Ten Receiver of the Year. He led the conference with 80 catches for 1,033 yards and eight touchdowns.
He finished his Maryland career with 146 catches, 2,027 receiving yards, and 17 touchdowns.
When he was 5, DJ Moore won a Little League championship wearing No. 2—the first number he remembers having—and he still has that jersey.
In his first three NFL seasons, DJ Moore set the Panthers’ franchise record for receiving yards by a wide receiver, with 3,055.
In 2023, DJ Moore became the fifth Bears receiver in team history to surpass 1,300 receiving yards; he finished with a career-high 1,364.
